entries.2f48026df38bdac7: The company is executing a three-year medium-term management plan starting from the fiscal year beginning April 2026, and its business strategy calls for "expanding focus businesses and promoting structural reform." It designates information security-related, photo imaging-related, mobility-related, industrial high-functionality materials-related, digital interface-related and semiconductor-related businesses as "focus businesses," and states that it will invest actively in them. The company will strengthen profitability of the "foundation businesses" and the "restructuring businesses," and states that in the restructuring businesses it will consider reducing or withdrawing from products and services with limited room for growth. Businesses expected to grow in the future will be developed as "growth potential businesses," and the company positions medical and healthcare-related businesses as one of them. On the financial side, the company plans to create funds for growth investment by reducing assets such as cross-shareholdings and by compressing cash on hand, and to allocate them to capital expenditure and to M&A in focus businesses and their surrounding fields.
